types.name: Day of the week for a date
types.description: A full date is given with no reference day (for example "What day of the week was 26 November 1994?") and you find the day using odd days.

types.name: Day from a known date
types.description: The day of the week for one date is given and you find the day for another date in a different month or year.

types.name: Counting days forward or back
types.description: "Today is Friday", or one day of a month is linked to a weekday, and you find the day after or before some number of days, or later in the same month.

types.name: Dates of events
types.description: Events, seminars or meetings happen a few days before or after each other, and you find a date (not a weekday) or match events to dates.

types.name: Leap years and repeating calendars
types.description: You pick which year is a leap year, or which year will have the same calendar as a given year.

types.name: Angle between the hands
types.description: You find the angle between the hour hand and the minute hand at a given time.

types.name: When the hands meet, oppose or make a right angle
types.description: You find the time between two given hours when the hands coincide, point in opposite directions or are at a right angle, or how many times this happens in a day.

types.name: Mirror image of a clock
types.description: You find the time shown by the mirror image (or the real time from the mirror image) of a clock.

types.name: Fast and slow clocks
types.description: A clock gains or loses minutes, and you find the correct time, the time shown, or how much it gains in a day.
